يرتبطون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَبِطُونَ (yartabiṭūna) /jar.ta.bi.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
# يُرْتَبَطُونَ (yurtabaṭūna) /jur.ta.ba.tˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَبَطَ (irtabaṭa)
